dataset: Original OECD PIAAC Cycle 2 respondent CSV in private library; 6517 rows
features: 27 encoded predictors; PCA only on seven workplace-use bands and years of paid work; PCA-derived four cluster-center distances appended to 27 original standardized inputs

split.inner: 22% of training split reserved for selecting PCA components and K-Means count (random_state=104)

preprocessing: Training-only median imputation and StandardScaler; train-only PCA, K-Means and cluster-distance scaler
scope: Occupation-family classification only; neural next-lesson recommendation is not trained
caveats: The previous project already used the same random holdout, so improvement is NOT independently validated
Four K-Means distances are appended to the global NN, not separate NNs per cluster
No raw individual respondent data published to GitHub
Complexity requires further country-held-out and new-sample evaluation before claiming robust improvements
